summary: Jaleco's San Francisco police-car racing game, developed by former Sega staff after Big Run and later ported to European home computers.

entries.title: Cisco Heat

emulation.notes: Use arcade emulation or original hardware for the primary route.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Arcade output with linked-cabinet features where preserved

primary.why: Cisco Heat was developed for arcade cabinets with upright, sit-down, and motion deluxe versions, and up to four cabinets could be linked for multiplayer. The home computer ports were later conversions and were received far less positively.
primary.how_to_play: Play the arcade version in MAME/original hardware; use home-computer ports only for comparison.

all_releases.fidelity: Original Jaleco arcade release with linked cabinet support and deluxe motion cabinet option.
Home-computer port published in Europe by Image Works.
